title: Artificial intelligence in diabetes management: Advancements, opportunities, and challenges

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Artificial intelligence in diabetes management: Advancements, opportunities, and challenges》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】The increasing prevalence of diabetes, high avoidable morbidity and mortality due to diabetes and diabetic complications, and related substantial economic burden make diabetes a significant health challenge worldwide.

evidence.text: The increasing prevalence of diabetes, high avoidable morbidity and mortality due to diabetes and diabetic complications, and related substantial economic burden make diabetes a significant health challenge worldwide.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Artificial intelligence in diabetes management: Advancements, opportunities, and challenges》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】A shortage of diabetes specialists, uneven distribution of medical resources, low adherence to medications, and improper self-management contribute to poor glycemic control in patients with diabetes.

evidence.text: A shortage of diabetes specialists, uneven distribution of medical resources, low adherence to medications, and improper self-management contribute to poor glycemic control in patients with diabetes.
